The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings. No non-branded page or query showed a repeatable combination of volume and positions 4–20.
searchConsole.decision: No new page is labeled Data-led because the sample cannot support one. The report instead informed discovery work: all three distinct intents are placed on the homepage, two department hubs and the Library, supported by twelve reciprocal contextual links, a regenerated sitemap and the publication manifest.
searchConsole.ignored: Two impressions for the jet-lag query at average position 8, two impressions for the contractor-estimate page at 8.5, one charity-page impression at 11 and six homepage impressions at 5.5 were deliberately ignored as too small, mixed or non-specific for a topic pivot or title rewrite.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the casual-shorts guide. The appliance and entryway field manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready major-appliance repair-or-replace decision matrix that separates immediate safety and recall checks, diagnosis quality, repair economics, remaining service value, operating-cost evidence, fit and installation constraints, and written closeout into one auditable file.
authority.cluster: Household ownership and consumer-decision authority, with reciprocal paths from the established appliance-delivery, warranty-registration, home-energy and insurance-inventory guides; the shorts and entryway pages expand separate clothing-fit and well-run-home clusters.
authority.opportunity: No outreach opportunity was added today; the asset and source trail were strengthened in place, and no outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Style and Life: how to choose casual shorts by rise, inseam, fabric and fit; how to decide whether a failed appliance merits repair or replacement; and how to run a safe, low-friction entryway. The shorts page serves purchase intent, the appliance matrix is the authority asset, and the entryway system explores a fresh household-operations problem. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
